searchText: The Cancun blockchain tests look to be completely broken. ``` evm blocktest ~/Projects/ethereum/tests/BlockchainTests/ValidBlocks/bcExample/basefeeExample.json INFO [03-26|21:23:01.038] Persisted trie from memory database nodes=3 size=401.00B time="5.898µs" gcnodes=0 gcsize=0.00B gctime=0s livenodes=0 livesize=0.00B test basefeeExample_Cancun: genesis block hash doesn't match test: computed=88f10c947876, test=3f820e969b47 ``` Check from latest develop Yes Dimitiry has fixed this The genesis hash is wrong. evmone reports the same. EthereumJS had it as well 🙂 There was an issue with beacon root logic being activated on genesis. Which is unclear from eip should it work on genesis or not. So I disabled it because genesis seems rather static. ok, just I cannot track all discord channels and GH issues + PRs. So I'm only tracking latest releases. And v13.2 is two weeks long. Should make a hot fix then Yeah I just checked I actually had a discussion with Dimitry on the EthereumJS dicord about this We can make a quick CI or I can check manually next time. My fault, I made a release too quick Will there be a 13.3 to address this? If someone wants to test without waiting for a release, EthereumJS failed 13.2 but passes on https://github.com/ethereum/tests/pull/1357
